literal: Hill-like those to decrease if considered, with family having stood-like those will perish from the earth.
translation: If one slights those whose greatness is like a mountain, even those who seem firmly established will perish from the earth along with their entire family.
modern: மலை போன்ற பெருமை உடையவர்களைச் சிறுமைப்படுத்தி அவமதித்தால், நிலைபெற்று நிற்பது போல் தோன்றுபவர்களும் தங்கள் குடும்பத்தோடு உலகிலிருந்து அழிந்து போவார்கள்.
explanation: The couplet warns against disrespecting people of immense, mountain-like greatness ('குன்று அன்னார்'). If someone looks down upon them or treats them lightly ('குன்ற மதிப்பின்'), the consequences are devastating. Even if the offenders seem deeply rooted and firmly established ('நின்று அன்னார்'), they will be completely wiped from the earth, taking their entire lineage ('குடியொடு') with them. The contrast between the unshakeable mountain and the offenders who only appear to stand firm highlights the destructive power of offending the truly great.
